description: This file defines the Zend_Validate class, which implements the Zend_Validate_Interface. It provides validation functionalities including adding validators, checking validity, managing default namespaces, and dynamic class loading for validation classes within the Zend Framework.

classes.name: Zend_Validate
classes.description: Main validation class implementing a chain of validators, managing validation messages, and dynamic validator class instantiation.

methods.name: addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the validation chain with optional chain-breaking on failure.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates a value against the chain of validators, returning true if all pass.

methods.name: getDefaultNamespaces
methods.description: Retrieves the default namespaces used for validation classes.

methods.name: setDefaultNamespaces
methods.description: Sets the default namespaces for validation classes.

methods.name: addDefaultNamespaces
methods.description: Adds new default namespaces to the existing set.

methods.name: hasDefaultNamespaces
methods.description: Checks if default namespaces are set.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Dynamically loads and instantiates a validation class by base name and checks if a value is valid.

methods.name: getMessageLength
methods.description: Gets the maximum message length for validation messages.

methods.name: setMessageLength
methods.description: Sets the maximum message length for validation messages.

methods.name: getDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Retrieves the default translation object for validation messages.

methods.name: setDefaultTranslator
methods.description: Sets the default translation object for validation messages.
